# Edge cases

## Labels

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> A
    A --> B: plain words
    A --> C: say #quot;hi#quot; #35;1
    A --> D: <b>bold</b> ok
    state Outer {
        [*] --> Inner
    }
    A --> Outer: go deeper
```

## Plain transition

A plain label binds as written.

## Entity transition

Written with Mermaid entity codes, so it is not bound.

## HTML transition

Written with HTML, so it is not bound.

## Composite

The composite state, with two charts of its own.

> ```mermaid
> stateDiagram-v2
>     X --> Y
> ```

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    P --> Q
```

## Size at the limit

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    A --> B: go
%% 
```
